title: Chapter 1275 - 27: Grand Dao Creation Of Yin And Yang
content:
Chapter 1275 - 27: Grand Dao Creation Of Yin And Yang

Chapter 1275: Chapter 27: Grand Dao Creation of Yin and Yang

The test space trembles, countless runes rapidly coalesce.

An unprecedented intertwining of energy, vast expanses of time and space, demonic qi all being obliterated.

But still, it’s hard to withstand.

"What happened?"

Inside the space, a golden figure’s complexion changes drastically.

As the ’spirit’ of the test space, he knows well the pressure the entire test space is under at this moment.

Tottering.

Could collapse at any moment.

But how is this possible?

The test space was opened by the great Master of Wushan.

As the Eternal Lord, the space he opens, even if done casually.

Cannot be shaken by beings at the level of the Third Realm.

This is a difference of ’quality.’

"Source Demons?"

"A group of Source Demons?"

The golden figure can only associate the direction towards Source Demons, speculating it might be a Source Demon siege.

But he denies this possibility in a flash; Source Demons are indeed strong, superior to the Eternal Sons.

But to shake this test space? The strength of Source Demons, stemming from the source of demonic disaster, is naturally strong.

Yet due to the secrecy of this test space, involving the essence of time and space, Source Demons simply can’t find it.

Even if they could find it, they couldn’t shake it.

As for Demon Gods?

Demon Gods need to suppress the central eternal sects of heaven and earth.

They simply don’t have the energy, nor the need to come here to obliterate this test space.

Bear in mind, since the Master of Wushan foresaw the descent of ’demonic’ disaster, the test space that he opened naturally is far more than just this one.

Lin Yuan only explored for hundreds to thousands of years before discovering this test space.

Indeed, luck played a part, but it wasn’t solely luck; the number of test spaces was truly considerable.

Aside from the Master of Wushan, other Eternal Lords also made respective arrangements.

The essence of the test space is a ’transit’ space, leading to the ultimate inheritance left by the Master of Wushan.

Such ’transit’ spaces, in this source world, there are many, with the purpose of screening cultivators who meet the test criteria as much as possible.

Destroying a ’transit’ space hardly affects the arrangements of the Master of Wushan.

Because the inheritance is still there, other ’transit’ test spaces are also still there.

Therefore.

Even if Demon Gods abandon the central eternal sects of heaven and earth, they wouldn’t specially come here to destroy this test space.

...

"No wonder it’s a space opened by the Eternal Lord."

Compared to the golden figure’s panic, Lin Yuan is somewhat amazed.

His true self uses this Taiyang Divine Spirit as a ’beacon,’ attempting to descend directly, yet it’s blocked by the endless runes outside the test space.

In fact, it can’t really be called blocked.

If Lin Yuan’s true self was truly intent on forcibly squeezing in, he could manage to do it.

But the consequence is this test space completely collapsing.

That contradicts Lin Yuan’s purpose.

His true self comes personally to acquire the inheritance left by the Master of Wushan.

Not to destroy this test space.

"This test space, involving energy fluctuations, only around the level of the Third Realm, presumably casually opened by the Master of Wushan, yet able to reach such a level?"

Lin Yuan mused to himself.

His true self surpasses the Third Realm by countless times.

Yet still cannot smoothly squeeze in.

It’s evident that the rules operating the test space are very high.

"Runes?"

Lin Yuan glanced at the endless runes around the test space, each individual rune seemingly insignificant in power, but when gathered, bursting forth with tens of thousands, hundreds of thousands, millions of times beyond its own might.

"Master of Wushan."

Lin Yuan grows more expectant of the inheritance left by this Eternal Lord.

...

"Little one, this test space probably can’t be preserved."

The golden figure turns to look at Lin Yuan, solemnly saying: "While you still have the capacity, immediately obliterate your flesh body."

Although the golden figure doesn’t believe Source Demons can lock onto this test space.

But for now, we can only prepare for the worst.

And if killed by demons, even if only an avatar is killed.

The mind and will would still be eroded by demonic qi, the entire true self will perish.

Therefore, facing invincible demons, the best approach is to directly obliterate the flesh body, avoiding contact with demons.

This is the reason why the golden figure wants Lin Yuan to proactively obliterate his body.

At least he can still survive.

"Obliterate the flesh body?"

Lin Yuan looks at the golden figure.

"Don’t worry, with this test space destroyed, there are other test spaces; just keep heading in this direction, you’ll find the next test space."

The golden figure speaks.

The test space opened by the Master of Wushan is plentiful, even with a collapse, it wouldn’t affect the overall layout.

With Lin Yuan’s talent and aptitude, there’s a slim hope to transcend the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, to pass the tests left by the Master of Wushan, being a hope among the cultivators of this world.

The golden figure naturally wants to preserve such a prodigy.

"Senior, you’ve misunderstood."

Lin Yuan immediately reacts, his true self’s descent causing the test space ’spirit’ before him to face a crisis, thinking a powerful Source Demon is attacking.

"Misunderstood?"

The golden figure looks at Lin Yuan.

At this moment, he also realizes something is off.

The trembling of the test space is detectable not only by him but also felt by Lin Yuan as the tester.

Yet there’s no sign of shock, panic, or similar emotions.

"It’s my true self arriving."

Lin Yuan says: "My true self was planning to descend directly to save you from the trouble of moving back and forth, senior."

Upon hearing this.

The golden figure immediately falls into silence.

So the one shaking the test space, causing it to teeter on the edge wasn’t ’demons,’ but the Lin Yuan before him?

Is it a cultivator?

The golden figure is momentarily unable to react.
